symbols.read: The bearish path has extended rather than reversed: price fell from 722.00 to 714.76 and the last 1H candle closed at 714.89 (-0.98%), so the SELL bias from the prior read is confirmed, not revised. The 722.40 pivot that broke previously now sits overhead as resistance alongside the open bear FVG at 726.00–726.48, and the 4H has flipped to Bearish, hardening the combined SELL stance within the still-BULLISH regime. Downside target remains 686.36; the bearish path is invalidated on a reclaim of 737.02, which would also require clearing the 722.40 and 726.00–726.48 caps. What changed versus the prior read: price broke lower instead of reclaiming 722.40, the 4H direction turned Bearish, and the 1H bear FVG at 721.95–722.12 is no longer listed as open.

The bearish bias holds and has strengthened: price fell from 81,534.59 to 81,311.64, extending the 1H downtrend with another red close (81,584.47→81,355.20, -0.28%) and pressing toward the 81,033.66 lower pivot. The invalidated short setup remains invalidated — price is still above the 81,033.66 entry and well below the 82,413.00 stop — but the drift lower now favors the original short thesis rather than the prior read's deteriorating profile. With no open FVGs, there is no overhead imbalance to slow a decline, and the 4H stays bearish within the BULLISH regime, keeping the combined tag SELL. A clean break below 81,033.66 reopens the path to 77,715.32; acceptance back above 84,352.00 is the invalidation that flips structure bullish.

Price has slid to 2,406.65, pressing directly on the 2,403.69 lower pivot that the prior read flagged as decisive — the bearish alignment (4H bearish, 1H down, combined SELL) is intact and the 2,446–2,455 bear FVG remains unmitigated overhead. The SELL setup is still tagged INVALIDATED with the stop at 2,402.67 sitting above entry, so there is still no clean short despite price now testing the trigger level. Bias stays bearish-leaning but unactionable until the pivot resolves: a sustained break below 2,403.69 re-arms the move toward 2,227.50, while a reclaim of 2,446 neutralizes the FVG and flips the picture. Invalidation for the bear case is that 2,446 reclaim; invalidation for the bull case is a hold below 2,403.69.

Bias remains bearish and the short stays invalidated: price at 103.44 sits further below the 107.16 lower pivot, so the 107.16 entry with stop 107.19 and target 100.92 still cannot be armed. What changed from the prior read is continued downside confirmation — price fell from 104.28 to 103.44, the last 1H print deepened to 104.34→103.62 (-0.69%) versus the prior -0.25%, and the 1H trend stays down against the 4H bearish direction for a combined SELL. With no open FVGs there is still no structural support beneath, keeping the path toward 100.92 open. Invalidation of the bearish lean remains a reclaim of 107.16; until that prints, the bias is unchanged and nothing is live.

Price is unchanged at 56.97, so the 4H bearish structure and SELL signal remain intact with no level breaks or trend flips to report. The 58.41 short entry stays expired and untriggered, with stop 58.58 and target 55.37 untouched, and the bearish FVG at 57.42–57.53 continues to cap as nearest supply. Bias stays bearish toward 55.37; a sustained reclaim of 58.41 invalidates the short thesis and flips the read bullish toward 61.45.

Price is unchanged at 4,165.42, so the read stays HOLD with the same neutral-to-long bias from the still-bullish 4H and up 1H trend. Nothing has broken: the 1H stall at 4,168.84 and the invalidated SELL at 4,141.44 are both intact, and with no open FVGs price is trading on structure alone between 4,217.40 and 4,141.44. The trigger set is unchanged — a sustained break below 4,141.44 flips the bias bearish and re-arms the 4,065.48 target, while a push through 4,217.40 confirms the long side. Conviction stays weak until one of those levels gives, so this is a confirmation of the prior read, not a revision.

Price extended the breakdown, sliding from 1.30 to 1.29 and putting further distance below the 1.31 lower pivot — the prior read's bearish structure is confirmed, not reversed. Bias stays neutral-to-short: 4H bearish, combined SELL, 1H trend down, with the two bear FVGs at 1.3154–1.328 and 1.3283–1.3297 still capping price as operative resistance. The only change is continued downside follow-through, no trend flip and no gap fill, so the read holds; the BULLISH regime flag still conflicts with the bearish 4H/1H structure and argues against chasing shorts into 1.20. Invalidation: a decisive hold above 1.3283–1.3297 voids the bearish structure and reopens 1.43; failure to reclaim 1.3154 keeps 1.20 in play.
